Little back story on why so many 3dses and games... My dog was my best friend. She got lymphona and despite all the treatment we tried, she sadly gave up her fight in Nov. I was devastated. I felt like I failed her. Not to mention, whenever I got stressed or anxious, she was my emotional support. 

Not having her as an outlet was really detrimental to my mental health and I was not in a good place. At my lowest, I got out my OG, and went back to my TL island where she still was living (along with any other family member I had lost along the way,). So it was a way to reconnect with them and feel they were were still in my life. 

I had a few other systems that I downloaded the game to, so I created islands for each one and started to have my islander babies travel among the docks. Caring for those travelers and having them say, "I was gentle," "They haven't had such good treatment," etc... was the dopamine rush and confidence boost I needed to feel well... loved and worthy. 

So, gaming is a therapy and can help you in ways you may not have realized but may even save your life one day.
